Name: Modern Stone Tile Floors for AT and CP

[size=4]Modern stone tile floors in 9 variations for Alternative Textures and Content Patcher.[/size]

This is my first mod, I hope you like it.

[i]Required mods:[/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]
﻿SMAPI[/url]﻿ 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246] ﻿Alternative Textures[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

Download either the Content Patcher or Alternative Textures version.
﻿Extract the file to the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley directory.
